name: yondr-marketing-requests
description: Yondr marketing request portal: brief, approve, produce and deliver marketing work (Cloudflare Worker + D1 + R2)

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply yondr-marketing-requests-db --remote && wrangler deploy
